headline: Gold prices in Pakistan fell by Rs10,800 per tola on Saturday to Rs409,736, while 10-gram gold dropped Rs9,259 to Rs351,282, Business Recorder reported citing APGJSA rates.

card.desc: 10 gram sona Rs9,259 kam ho kar Rs351,282 ka ho gaya.

caption:
Sone ki qeemat mein Rs10,800 ki bari kami!
Business Recorder ke mutabiq Saturday ko fi tola sona Rs10,800 sasta ho kar Rs409,736 ka ho gaya, jab ke 10 gram sona Rs9,259 kam ho kar Rs351,282 par aa gaya. International market mein sona $108 gir kar $3,872 per ounce aur chandi fi tola Rs142 kam ho kar Rs5,388 ho gayi.
